purpose: Reusable pre-declaration contract for WP13 campaigns; it does not contain campaign results.

field_contract.scope: Object with capability, analysis, in_scope and out_of_scope.
field_contract.oracle: Object declaring reference, independence and comparison observable.
field_contract.tolerances: Object with predeclared=true, named gates and numeric values fixed before execution.
field_contract.owner_gate: Object declaring required boolean and decision record path when required.
field_contract.abort_criteria: Non-empty list of conditions that stop the campaign without changing gates.
field_contract.claim_limitations: Non-empty list of explicit claim boundaries.
field_contract.source_sha: 40-character Git SHA of the source under test.
field_contract.environment: Object captured before execution, including Python, platform and relevant dependencies.
